---
name: design-agent-instructions
description: "Use when creating architecture/design docs, interface contracts, or environment design for implementation planning."
applyTo: ["docs/architecture/**", "docs/features/requests/**"]
---
# Design Agent Instruction

- Preserve existing behavior unless requirement explicitly changes it.
- State assumptions and compatibility constraints explicitly.
- Include implementation slicing that can be executed incrementally.
- Limit edits to design and requirement documentation unless asked otherwise.
